grammar.title: 语法知识 小测试
lines: 3 每日习语 Fall on deaf ears 充耳不闻；言者无心，听者无意
The new school, which has just been completed, is a fine building. ℘
He denied that he had taken it. (denied/refused)
The waiter fetched me a clean glass. (took/fetched)
A bird flew past my window. (past/passed)
I spent the afternoon watching the match. (watching/following)
Ships continuously cross the sea. ( continuously / continually )
The bank has been robbed . ( stolen /robbed)
